Name: Speedy Mail
Author: Alexa314
Description:
This mod optimizes HandleActionCommand from an O(n^2) algorithm to an O(n) algorithm, along with making overly large strings not get displayed to reduce lag in menus. This isn't useful for any normal gameplay purposes, and exists solely to facilitate extremely long names which execute code. When dealing with normal length strings, it's very possible this overhead slightly worsens lag, though it's hard to test because computers do it so fast.

I repeat, please don't install this mod unless you are playing the game with names that are in the thousands or tens of thousands of characters long.

If you are installing it, then I hope you're experimenting with the same things I am (making ginormous names which execute exciting code), in which case let me know.

Manifest.Name: SpeedyMail
Manifest.Description: This mod is built to make executing code through the mail significantly faster
